def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    holes = image_patch.find("hole")
    nits = image_patch.find("nit")
    if not holes or not nits:
        return image_patch
    hole_centers = [(h.left + h.right) / 2, (h.lower + h.upper) / 2 for h in holes]
    nit_centers = [(n.left + n.right) / 2, (n.lower + n.upper) / 2 for n in nits]
    distances = [math.sqrt((hc[0] - nc[0]) ** 2 + (hc[1] - nc[1]) ** 2) for hc, nc in zip(hole_centers, nit_centers)]
    min_distance_index = distances.index(min(distances))
    return nits[min_distance_index]
